name: slack
description: Messages from the Slack conversations you are in, read through Slack's own API with a token for an app you create. Read-only: it has no permission to post.

requires.help: Create a Slack app for yourself from extractors/slack/slack-app.json, install it to your workspace, and save its "User OAuth Token" (starts with xoxp-) in that file. Steps: docs/LOCAL.md, "Slack". A work Slack may need an admin to approve the app, and your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
